pixelEncoding: 2 bits per pixel, 4 pixels per byte (first pixel in the high bits), 80 bytes per row, base64

glyphs.source: marker and arrowDown measured from a screenshot of the original; other arrows derived

marker.note: CHR$(16); PUT at (300, 174 - oxygen * 0.043), the glyph's pixels start at +1,+3

scope.horizon: 79 - 4 * depth (79 with the periscope up above depth 46; -1 when negative) = ds:0x2152

needles.note: heading in math radians (0 = east); the label 0 is at the top

dynamic.hubs: circle r4 aspect .9 at each needle centre (already in the static layer)

lights.note: on while the diesels charge the battery (v218a < 1000 and diesel)

oxygenMarker.note: CHR$(16) right-pointing triangle, PUT with PSET

tubes.digitAction: XOR: white on a ready (magenta) tube, cyan on an empty one
tubes.readyWhen: (4 - tube) < torpedoes left and the tube is not running (A1172[tube] = 0)

dynamic.note: overlays are drawn under the cyan hull; lightOn replaces the empty ring when the compartment's damage > 0

dynamic.usable: depth <= 45 (otherwise the sweep and blips are not drawn)

dynamic.islandRule: key = attr_5 + '_' + attr_6 of the quadrant's MXP row; the picture is drawn with the pen at the island centre, outline colour 3, fill colour 1
dynamic.outerRing: 40 dots in colour 2 on an ellipse of the outer radius (0x0ca22, 0.0638 x / 0.0398 y per world unit)
dynamic.trails: positions are PSET and never erased: own boat colour 1 (green), ships colour 2
dynamic.ownBoat: DRAW 'S4C3BF4BD7E2L2U2R3E3H2G2HE5FG2F2E6FG9R9D2L10G3H' (boat symbol) at the boat position in quadrant 5 only; label 'X'

rows.format: name LEFT$(15), tonnage USING '######', 6 spaces, date, '1943'

dynamic.flag: 50-star flag emblem at x 125..165, y 0..24 (stripes colour 2, canton colour 1, stars colour 3)

dynamic.hidden: Z (PASSWORD? PAED) coordinate prompt at LOCATE 1,1
